Subject: MAP: Trial environment dependency assignments (VPC, SSO, KMS)

Hi Mark — thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, attached is a working draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the 3-week trial. Below is a short summary and the specific environment dependencies we need to lock down so the trial environment can be provisioned on schedule.

High-level target dates
- Target POC environment ready: 2026-07-24
- Trial run window: 2026-07-27 to 2026-08-03
- Target commercial close (if trial meets success criteria): 2026-08-12

Key MAP milestones & owners (draft)
- M1: Network setup (VPC peering + IP allowlist) — owner: Altera NetOps (please confirm) — due: 2026-07-16
- M2: SSO/SAML test account + metadata exchange — owner: Altera security — due: 2026-07-20
- M3: Secrets/KMS access for model keys — owner: Altera infra/security; Redwood SE to validate integration — due: 2026-07-21
- M4: Redwood environment provisioning & smoke tests — owner: Redwood (Diego) — due: 2026-07-24

POC environment dependencies (technical)
1) VPC peering or private connectivity: we will need either cross-account VPC peering or a peered transit subnet that allows our serving nodes to reach your test VPC. Specifics: allow outbound to Redwood egress CIDR ranges (see attached redwood_ip_ranges.csv).
2) IP allowlists / firewall rules: add the CIDR blocks from the attachment to your allowlist for the test subnet and any API endpoints that will be called by Redwood.
3) SSO/SAML: we support SAML 2.0 (SP-initiated + IdP-initiated). We require a test user with admin scope to validate console access and to test session flows. If you use Okta/Azure AD, we have integration docs attached.
4) Secrets/KMS: for the trial we can work with either your AWS KMS CMKs or a short-lived secret injected via a secure transfer — permanent KMS binding will be recommended for production.

Attachments: MAP_altera_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Next steps / asks
- Please confirm network owner and point of contact (NetOps) so Diego can schedule the technical preflight.
- Confirm whether you can meet the M1 due date (2026-07-16). If not, propose the earliest date.
- If SSO integration will require vendor procurement or a security approval board, flag that now so we can plan a fallback (temporary API key injection for the trial).

I can be the engagement owner on our side — Diego will be the SE lead and Karthik will be your AE. Happy to hop on a short technical sync — propose Mon Jul 12 10:00 PT if that works for your team.

Thanks,

Hi Mark / Grace — looping in technical details to answer the SSO/KMS/IP questions before Monday's sync.

Network / IPs
- For the trial we only need outbound connectivity from your VPC to Redwood (no inbound ports opened into your VPC). That is, your test instances must be able to reach our API endpoints and artifact storage. 
- Attached is redwood_ip_ranges.csv with the egress CIDR blocks we use for trial clusters. Please add those to your egress allowlist; if your firewall requires a source IP set, use the list as source ranges for our connections.

SSO / SAML
- Redwood supports SAML 2.0 (SP-initiated and IdP-initiated). We support NameID = email and persistent; we recommend email for easier test account mapping.
- For the trial you can create a single test user (email) with admin rights for the session test. Our SSO integration checklist (attached) includes the metadata exchange and a list of attributes we request (email, name, groups).

KMS / secrets
- We support AWS KMS CMKs. For the trial a narrowly scoped IAM role allowing kms:Decrypt on the specific key is sufficient. Minimal permission set: kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey (on the CMK ARN). If you prefer not to provide KMS access for the trial, we can accept a short-lived secret injected into the environment via a one-time secure transfer; this is a tradeoff (less integration fidelity, but faster).

Timeline & effort estimate
- If NetOps can provision peering and allowlists by 2026-07-16 and Security provides the SSO metadata by 2026-07-20, Redwood can provision and smoke-test the environment by 2026-07-24 (3 business days for provisioning + testing).

Attachments: redwood_ip_ranges.csv, sso-integration-guide.pdf

I will be available on the Mon Jul 12 tech sync and can run through the preflight checklist step-by-step.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
